the evaluation of Tween 80 for its anticancer activity in reticulum cell (lymphosarcoma) sarcoma of the SJL/J mouse.

the evaluation of Tween 80 as a potential anticancer agent in the SJL mouse tumor system and with the investigation of factors that might influence its inhibitory effects on tumor development in this system.
the development of Tween 80 (a non-toxic surfactant) as a cancer chemopreventive agent for use in the SJL tumor model.
